confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Madeira and Portugal pricing for July peak season; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Hotel and hostel anchors are least certain because July rates in Funchal vary widely by season, location, and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine anchors are set from the local beer and restaurant price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. FX value taken from RBA summary-page search results, not from the F11 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Portuguese coastal and island tourist destinations with comparable restaurant pricing and summer accommodation demand, adjusted for Funchal's Madeira location and July peak-season hotel and hostel rates.
